verdict.basis: missing_blanking_u=5 meets the >=3 trigger of rule 8. Note usable_free_u=7 would otherwise have satisfied rule 10 (adequate); the airflow deficiency is what constrains this cabinet, not the amount of space.

not_determinable.note: Single frontal image. Available U may be unusable if equipment protrudes behind the rail.
Power compartment not visible. 7U usable does NOT imply 7U of expansion capacity.

findings.text: 5 open rack units have no blanking panels fitted (U2-U5, U25), permitting hot air recirculation across the cabinet face.
findings.recommendation: Fit blanking panels to all five positions. No equipment change required.

findings.text: A cable bundle obscures U6-U7 with approximately 72% coverage. These positions are reported as occluded and excluded from free space.
findings.recommendation: Dress the bundle into the side cable manager so these positions become assessable.

findings.text: U26-U42 classified as unknown_hardware at 0.58 confidence. Counted as occupied per fail-closed rule.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the installed equipment against the site record; if this is a recognised model, add it to the equipment catalogue.

narrative: This 42U cabinet has 9 free rack units, of which 7 are realistically usable: U2-U3 are consumed as required clearance above the baseband, and U6-U7 could not be assessed behind a cable bundle. The constraint here is not space but airflow - five open positions lack blanking panels, which is what drives the limited verdict. Fitting five panels is a no-risk change that would move this cabinet to adequate. Note that usable depth and spare power capacity could not be determined from a single frontal image, so 7U should not be read as 7U of installable capacity without a site check.
